title: Artifact Resource Firewall: deliverable labels stop leaking into Course FAQ concepts

claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.37 Genetics and Society audit produced Quality 74/C with a P0 because a single supporting resource label, slide decks, appeared in Course FAQ answers as lesson evidence.
proofCommands: Manual EduTool.dev console/UI audit summarized in docs/V0.15.38_ARTIFACT_RESOURCE_FIREWALL_ROADMAP.md from verification-output/edutool-audit-loop/20260620T200413Z/

claims.summary: Course Map readiness repair now treats exact single supporting-resource cells that are requested deliverable labels as prompt-artifact contamination for normal disciplinary courses.
The repair excludes worked examples from the exact single-resource artifact set, preserving the v0.15.12 precision fix for legitimate worked-example support resources.
A focused compiler regression proves repaired Genetics Course FAQ text no longer says Strong work uses slide decks or carries the leaked slide decks label.

The finalize flow now emits the run digest after quality grading has been merged, and the digest records finalize-time quality P0s as failed quality checks instead of leaving a misleading ready audit record.

carryForward.next: The fresh run still showed genome 0/4 and one source-ledger row in native_c1_source_truth; continue source-ledger bridge and concept-linking work.
Resolve ambiguous source-license P2 findings through the source-license policy work instead of hiding them in the grader.
